subpages.text: Home About Solutions News Contact Home About Solutions News Contact F-ENGINE S2200ME-PAF Carrier Ethernet POE Switch F-engine S2200ME-PAF series products are newly-released carrier Ethernet PoE (Power over Ethernet)switches. They include S2208ME-PAF, S2216ME-PAF, and S2224ME-PAF family members. S2208ME-PAF offers 8*10/100Base-TX（PoE）port + 2*ComboG port (10/100/1000Base-T or 100/1000Base-X); S2216ME-PAF offers 16*10/100Base-TX（PoE）port + 2*ComboG port (10/100/1000Base-T or 100/1000Base-X); S2224ME-PAF offers 24*10/100Base-TX（PoE）port + 2*ComboG port(10/100/1000Base-T or 100/1000Base-X). Major Features: 1. Rich service support capability F-engine S2200ME-PAF series Ethernet switches support PoE(Power over Ethernet) technology, allow IP telephones, wireless LAN Access Points, webcams and many other connected appliances to receive power as well as data over existing LAN cabling, without needing to use the additional power supply that facilitate the network deployment and management. S2200ME-PAF comply with both IEEE802.3af and IEEE802.3at international standards, enable supplying power with network device which works over 15.4W power, which fully meet the latest demand of power supply from costumers. 2. Powerful control ability for user access S2200ME-PAF support 802.1x, which requests identification authentication when subscriber accesses network and offers remote function testing and trouble-shooting. It enables the user access limitation via MAC address number, support MAC address and port-based binding, maximally ensure the validity of user access. S2200ME-PAF enable port/VLAN based rate limiting function, support rate control over ingress/egress port with the minimal granularity of 64Kbps, which contribute to prevent malicious action from occupying network bandwidth.

FHN bundled products and solutions to span the entire area of IP-based communication, including router, switch, Carrier-class Ethernet Multi-Service Platform, namely CESP, CWDM, EOS, media converter, and IPTV system so as to maximize the key points of difference. The F-engine series switches are awarded the top brand in Asia. The network of sale and package services has shaped among the business of Telecom, Industry and International. At present, the branch of provincial capital has stretched to the whole China and provides service for telecom, radio film and television, energy, financial, education and government institution. With respect to international business, dozens of countries are benefited from the products through mutual cooperation with foreign agencies and OEM/ODM. In addition, it helps Southeast Asia countries to build its national core network. FHN attaches great importance to the development of ongoing technologies and up-to-date solutions. FHN holds the independent research and development technologies for ASIC and IP core-level chip and pose the main player in domestic market. F-engine M8416E series products, acting as the fabric of carrier-class IP-based transport network, pose an important engine for services roll-out. F-ENGINE M8416E series Carrier Ethernet Multi-service Platform, which developed by FHN Networks, dedicate to the IP-based Metro network which calling for manageable and operational. It pools the latest technologies and standards in terms of Carrier Ethernet to facilitate the operators rolling out their profit-orient services, including broadband service, TDM and data service, video services and so on. Thanks to the low cost and high scalability, it also widely had been opted for the main player in the area of key account and enterprise network which provides a private network in cost-effective way. In addition, F-engine M8416E series products play a vital role in 3G and other emerging services.
